title: comfy model upload --json data payload
description: One local .safetensors file and its place in the Comfy Cloud model library. A real upload succeeds only once Comfy Cloud's hash of the stored file equals `hash`. `uploaded` is true when this run added it; `already_present` is true when the library already held these bytes under this name and folder (nothing was uploaded); a `dry_run` uploads nothing and says which of the two a real run would do. `loader_path` is the value a loader widget in a workflow takes for the model on Comfy Cloud (for a dry run that would upload, the value it will have). `sha256` is the hash to show a person and pass back as `--expected-sha256`.

id.description: The asset id; null for a dry run of a file Comfy Cloud does not have yet.

hash.description: The file's BLAKE3 hash, the one Comfy Cloud stores it under.

workspace_id.description: The workspace checked against --workspace; null when --workspace was not given.

task_id.description: The server task that stored the file; null when nothing was uploaded.
